<?php
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

final class AC_WPTB_REST {
	private const NS = 'agadir-concept-test-bridge/v1';

	public static function init(): void {
		add_action( 'rest_api_init', array( __CLASS__, 'routes' ) );
	}

	public static function routes(): void {
		register_rest_route(
			self::NS,
			'/status',
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'callback'            => array( __CLASS__, 'status' ),
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
			)
		);
		register_rest_route(
			self::NS,
			'/remote',
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'callback'            => array( __CLASS__, 'remote' ),
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
			)
		);
	}

	public static function status(): WP_REST_Response {
		return rest_ensure_response(
			array(
				'version'              => defined( 'AC_WPTB_VERSION' ) ? AC_WPTB_VERSION : '1.2.1',
				'active'               => AC_WPTB_Core::is_enabled(),
				'expires_at'           => AC_WPTB_Core::enabled_until() ? gmdate( 'c', AC_WPTB_Core::enabled_until() ) : null,
				'fingerprint'          => AC_WPTB_Core::fingerprint(),
				'namespace'            => self::NS,
				'full_control'         => AC_WPTB_Full_Control::is_enabled(),
				'full_control_expires' => AC_WPTB_Full_Control::enabled_until() ? gmdate( 'c', AC_WPTB_Full_Control::enabled_until() ) : null,
				'jobs'                 => AC_WPTB_Jobs::status()['last'] ?? array(),
				'runtime_error_count'  => count( AC_WPTB_Runtime::errors() ),
			)
		);
	}

	public static function remote( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$verified = AC_WPTB_Core::verify_remote_control( $request, false );
		if ( is_wp_error( $verified ) ) {
			return $verified;
		}
		return self::status();
	}
}
